_readme: Section-level successor mapping for repealed law.
Act-level repeal lives in statutes.ACTS via current/status plus successor metadata.
This file provides the finer-grained correspondence claim (for example, CrPC 154 -> BNSS 173).
These mappings must be treated as retrieval guidance, not as a substitute for reading the current statute.
The IPC mappings were sourced from the NCRB BNS concordance. The CrPC and Indian Evidence Act
mappings in this file are sourced from NCRB's corresponding-section tables for BNSS and BSA.
Section keys are uppercased, so use 304B not 304b.
Anything absent falls back to the act-level notice, which is safer than inventing a section mapping.
Run `python -m app.eval_validity` after editing to check the file parses and that no mapping points at a section
that does not exist in the current indexed corpus.
_schema_v2: ADDED, additive to the original file.
2. crpc:* and iea:* SECTION mappings alongside the original ipc:* mappings.
repealed   no longer in force; successor_act_key says what replaced it
amending   an amendment act; modifies another act, never stands alone
successor  in force, and it is what replaced a repealed act
The section mappings for BNSS and BSA below have been checked against the NCRB corresponding-section tables.

ipc.note: Repealed with effect from 1 July 2024. Still governs offences committed before that date.
ipc.source: Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, s.358 (repeal and savings)

crpc.note: Repealed with effect from 1 July 2024. Proceedings pending on that date continue under the CrPC.
crpc.source: Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, s.531 (repeal and savings)

iea.source: Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023, s.170 (repeal and savings)

pocso.act: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012

jj.act: Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015
